subject: Checking Q2 timing and budget — Redwood demo follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmecorp.com>; Paul Nguyen <paul.ops@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (Redwood & Acme)

Thanks again for your time today, Jordan and Paul — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Need: fast, predictable inference for customer-facing chat with strict latency SLOs and token-cost constraints.
- Current constraints: batch sizes are variable, multi-region requirement (US + EU), and procurement has a July review window.
- Success metrics you mentioned: p95 latency < 300ms, cost per 1k tokens under $X (approx), and retention of user context across sessions.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send the demo deck and an exec summary with recommended model/config options for your workload (SSE + KV caching + quantization profile).
2) Rishi (cc’d) can run a short perf profile with a 1k-message sample once you send anonymized payloads/trace.
3) Schedule a 45-min technical demo with our infra lead (Vivek) next week to walk through deployment/SLAs.

Tentative timeline you mentioned: procurement review in early July and pilot decision by mid-July. If that changes please flag.

Attachments: Redwood-demo-deck.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

--
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.ops@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 14:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (Redwood & Acme)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers: 

- Timeline: procurement review is scheduled for 07/07, exec sign-off target 07/14. Still on track but budget needs a final OK from finance.
- Payloads: I can share a sanitized sample by EOD Friday — I’ll remove PII.
- Demo: 7/1 or 7/2 works for the technical deep-dive; prefer afternoon pacific.

Can you also include a rough cost estimate for a pilot (4-8 GPUs) and what SLA tiers look like for Dedicated vs Hosted? Paul — looped you for finance input on budget expectations.

Jordan
Director, Product Platform | Acme Corp
jordan.price@acmecorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (Redwood & Acme)

Perfect — thanks, Jordan. Scheduling: I’ll send a calendar invite for 7/1 1:00pm PT for the technical demo (Vivek + Rishi attending).

Attached is the demo deck plus a short one-pager with pilot cost bands (ballpark only; final quote after workload profile): SOW-draft-acme.docx (word).

Also adding a short breakdown here: Hosted (fast onboarding, usage pricing) vs Dedicated (reserved capacity, predictable throughput + SLAs). I’ll call out expected p95 numbers and a pilot estimate in the invite.

If procurement timing slips, we can do a short pilot under Hosted while you finalize Dedicated capacity procurement — that’s a common path.

Thanks,
Marissa
Attachment: Redwood-demo-deck.pdf (application/pdf); SOW-draft-acme.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick Q: End-of-quarter check — is July procurement still on track?

Jordan — looping in a quick ping as EoQ approaches on our side and to check whether your procurement window/priority has shifted since our call. A few quick items: 

- Is the 07/07 procurement review still on the calendar? Any risk of delay to exec approval (target 07/14)?
- Has budget authority changed or should we expect any additional stakeholders to review the SOW?
- If timing is tight, we can propose a 4-week pilot on Hosted with an extension credit applied to Dedicated if you convert within 60 days — happy to document that in the SOW.

We’re trying to finalize resource allocation for early July demos and pilot capacity; if procurement moves later it impacts our ability to reserve Dedicated slots in the preferred week. Totally understand many orgs push at quarter boundaries — if it helps I can set a short call with Procurement + Finance to speed approvals.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll assume July timeline still stands and we’ll proceed with the 7/1 technical demo. Would you like the Commissioning SOW updated with the pilot/credit language before the demo?

Thanks for the quick check — appreciate it.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: SOW-draft-acme.docx
